identity: Every opaque memory-only session is created by the controller for exactly one active locale and BPM version. Locale mismatch rejects context; version mismatch deletes the session before retrieval or inference.

retention.eviction: Keep the newest eight completed user-question/assistant-answer pairs as sixteen chronological entries. No model-generated summary is created or persisted.

follow_up: The existing resolved entities from accepted local evidence are appended to the next retrieval query only within the exact session locale/version. The fresh request still performs same-locale retrieval and M5 evidence/citation validation; prior citations never become citations for the new answer.
topic_and_citation_reset: If the accepted current evidence has no topic identity in common with the session, retain bounded dialogue but discard stale resolved entities before worker generation. A version change deletes the session. Every answer binds only citations from its fresh current EvidencePack.
clear: Clear removes the exact session, turns, entities, topic identities and all handles. A missing or cleared session cannot provide context.
